notes.title: AH3X v1.01 Minor update (2021/06/21)
notes.content:
【Patch fix list】

・Fixed the display for LP and VP values in the results screen at Ranking menu.
*Also, we will need to reset all player's data for this fix to be effective. In addition, the Weekly LP rankings will have to remain with the error values until the next weekly reset.

・Fixed an issue where the game clones a huge number of characters on screen and other display bugs in the training mode while waiting for online matchings.

・Fixed some issues where certain achievements could not be unlocked.

・Fixed an issue where the game crashes upon selecting Dark Heart in Simple Mode, for Versus game mode.

・Fixed an issue where the Player IDs are displayed off-axis in network modes.

The list below contains issues we were unable to reproduce, but have fitted in countermeasures in attempt to fix them:
・The game crashing upon selecting Network Mode, and after display of a short "Downloading..." message

・Fixed an issue where the game crashes upon selecting Dark Heart in Simple Mode, for Versus game mode.
・Fixed an issue where the Player IDs are displayed off-axis in network modes.
・The game crashing upon selecting Network Mode, and after display of a short "Downloading..." message

notes.title: 【Ver1.08】Update Notice（2018.03.08）
notes.content:
The following issues have been fixed/implemented in this patch:

・Against Parace L'sia (CPU Boss), fixed a bug where "Konoha Hyaku Bunshin no Jutsu (Konoha Hundred Clone Technique)" does not land a hit properly.
・Fixed a bug where the last hit of the Arcana Eclipse for the Arcana of Sin had been an off-the-ground hit previously.

==========================================================
We are still tackling many other issues in the meantime, and are aiming to release more patches in the very near future. We seek your kind patience and understanding in this matter.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: 【Ver1.06】Update Notice（2018.01.24）
notes.content:
The following issues have been fixed in this patch:

・Fixed the high frame rate/high game speed issue when user sets "Vertical Synchronization" to OFF in their NVIDIA Control Panel 3D settings.
・Fixed a hang bug where the game stops responding when the battle timer reaches "00".
・Fixed several graphics errors.
・Fixed an issue where the game was unable to be booted up due to a "nt.dll" error.

==========================================================
We are still tackling many other issues in the meantime, and are aiming to release more patches in the very near future. We seek your kind patience and understanding in this matter.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: 【Ver1.05】Update Notice（2018.01.10）
notes.content:
The following issues have been fixed in this patch:

・Fixed a display bug where the win rate for Minori in VP Rankings do not appear correctly.
・Fixed a crashing bug where the game will crash when too many people use the voice chat system in a single player room.
・Partially fixed an issue where charge commands do not get played back corrected in Training Mode's memory playback. (Fixed for when using the shortcut button to replay the memory, but still attending to the other replay method when using Select+Y function.)

==========================================================
We are still tackling many other issues in the meantime, and are aiming to release more patches in the very near future. We seek your kind patience and understanding in this matter.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: 【Ver1.04】Update Notice（2017.12.28）
notes.content:
The following issues have been fixed in this patch:

・Fixed the noise clippings in many instances of various sound clips.
・Re-introduced the missing character colors.
・Fixed an issue where choosing the "Random" selector will not select both "Minori Amanohara" and "Ichor the Blood Arcana".
・Fixed an issue where the stage BGM for "Ragnarok Hanger" is being played back slower than expected.
・Fixed an issue where the new Six Stars BGMs do not get played back at the correct speed in the Gallery Mode.
・Fixed an issue where the "Player's Skill Level" does not appear correctly while searching for a room in Player Match.
・Fixed an issue where in Training Mode, while controlling 2P, 1P's character will automatically perform the homing dash whenever the player attempts to reset the position.

We are still tackling many other issues in the meantime, and are aiming to release more patches in the very near future. We seek your kind patience and understanding in this matter.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: 【Ver1.01】Update Notice（2017.12.15）
notes.content:
In this update we have fixed the reported issue of the game going into abnormally high game speed when using a High-Refreshrate monitor (typically of over 60Hz).

We are also tackling other issues in the meantime, and are aiming to release more patches in the very near future. We seek your kind patience and understanding in this matter.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.
